android.releaseNotes:
• Liquid Glass Modal Sheets: Authentic Apple optical refraction on attachment options and message long-tap sheets.
• Revamped Attachment Context Sheets: Sleek floating liquid glass cards with metadata chips, view mode selectors, and dismissal actions.
• Native Predictive Back Gestures: Unrestricted page peel & pop navigation across Chat and Settings screens.
• 120Hz Smooth Scrolling: RepaintBoundaries and cache optimizations eliminate frame drops in conversation streams.
• E2EE Notification Decryption: Incoming FCM notifications automatically decrypt Signal/PQ-Aura payloads locally.
